const errors = []
page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
await page.addInitScript(() => {
  window.transitionLog = []
  const original = document.startViewTransition.bind(document)
  document.startViewTransition = options => {
    const log = { types: [...(options.types || [])] }
    window.transitionLog.push(log)
    const transition = original(options)
    transition.ready.then(() => {
      log.animations = document.getAnimations().map(animation => ({
        name: animation.animationName,
        pseudo: animation.effect?.pseudoElement,
        timing: animation.effect?.getTiming(),
        keyframes: animation.effect?.getKeyframes(),
      }))
      log.participants = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(element => getComputedStyle(element).viewTransitionName "'!== '"'none').map(element => ({
        name: getComputedStyle(element).viewTransitionName,
        classes: getComputedStyle(element).viewTransitionClass,
      }))
    }).catch(error => { log.error = error.message })
    transition.finished.then(() => { log.finished = true }).catch(error => { log.error = error.message })
    return transition
  }
})

await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle')
await page.locator('.product-card').first().click()
await page.waitForURL('**/product/classic-sneakers')

assert(forward.some(log => log.types.includes('nav-forward')))
assert(forward.some(log => log.animations?.some(animation => animation.name === 'page-slide')))
assert(forward.some(log => log.participants?.some(participant => participant.name === 'product-classic-sneakers' && participant.classes.includes('product-image-morph'))))
assert("'!forward.some(log => log.error))
await page.evaluate(() => { window.transitionLog = [] })
await page.getByRole('"'link', { name: 'Back to products' }).click()
await page.waitForURL('http://localhost:3000/')
await page.waitForFunction(() => window.transitionLog.length && window.transitionLog.every(log => log.finished || log.error))
const back = await page.evaluate(() => window.transitionLog)
console.log('BACK', JSON.stringify(back, null, 2))
assert(back.some(log => log.types.includes('nav-back')))
assert(back.some(log => log.animations?.some(animation => animation.name === 'page-slide')))
assert("'!back.some(log => log.error))

console.log('REDUCED', JSON.stringify(reduced, null, 2))
assert("'!reduced.some(log => log.error))

const pulse = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const skeleton = document.createElement('"'div')

})
